payload.leagueSummary: This rolling window is basically a knife fight at the top of NET, with KeithK75 and IUDoc92 both piling up wins while Dan94 keeps living in the gross-podium neighborhood without cashing the net tickets. Under the hood, KeithK75 is the cleanest all-around weapon in the league, Dan94 is the bomber who actually turns distance into scoring, and a few others are surviving on one hot phase while the rest of the bag catches fire in the wrong direction. The big story is separation: the leaders are separating with complete tee-to-green games, while the back half is leaking strokes in all the familiar ways—missed greens, ugly putting, and enough doubles to make a goat cry.
leagueBullets: KeithK75 is the most complete profile in the window: elite tee-to-green, elite gross, and enough net results to back it up. That’s not luck; that’s a dude beating the course in three different ways.

Dan94 and MattF are the best proof that you can still post if the driver is cooperating and the putter isn’t a total asshole. Dan94 is the cleaner killer, while MattF’s sample is smaller but the ceiling is loud.

The ugly end is getting dragged by weak long-game and pile-up putting: DREADFUL and MashedBROtato are losing strokes in all the dumb places, and IUDoc92 keeps winning net while the gross game still looks like it got mugged on the turn.
